text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: Speed Symboli. Would you talk to me?

text_block_list.name: Speed Symboli
text_block_list.text:
"A chat? ...About the races? Or perhaps 
you'd prefer a bedtime story, like old 
times?"

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Heh, 'night talks'... You mean that 
sleep-depriving nuisance where you just 
recklessly strum your guitar and sing?

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
That should be enough, right? 'Su-san' 
hasn't noticed. So that means I win the 
bet, yeah?

text_block_list.name: Speed Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Just as I thought. Whenever you two team 
up, it's always a safe bet you're up to no 
good. So, what did you bet onâ

text_block_list.name: Speed Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Whether I'll go back to my old way of 
speaking... is that it? Ramonu bet that I 
would, while Sirius bet against it. What 
do you think?

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
...Thank you for that splendid display of 
insight. Ramonu, the farce is over—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
"Talk to me, Speed Symboli. —I want to 
meet the you from back then."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
I love you when you're wrapped in your 
ideals. And yet, standing in the meadow, 
whistling softly... I want to see... that 
gentle side of you.

text_block_list.name: Speed Symboli
text_block_list.text:
"...Ramonu, you're as lovely as ever. 
However, my love—"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
Enough already. Sirius, come out to the 
grounds later.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
"...Hey, you did that on purpose, didn't 
you? You're way too soft on Ramonu."

text_block_list.name: Speed Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Now this is troubling. I thought I 
indulged everyone equally. So please, 
don't pout like that—my star.
